title: Home Depot’s Labor Day Sale: BOGO Offers on Our Favorite Grills and Tools
gist: A WIRED shopping roundup of Home Depot's 2026 Labor Day sale highlights discounts on Traeger and Weber grills plus BOGO battery deals on Milwaukee, Ryobi, and DeWalt power tools, while flagging that the retailer's smart-home and security deals (including Ring) aren't worth buying.

insights.claim: Home Depot discounted Traeger's entry-level Pro 22 wood pellet grill from $550 to $390 (29% off) for Labor Day 2026, which the reviewer says is the lowest price the model has seen all year.
insights.speaker: Matthew Korfhage
insights.so_what: A consumer-deals data point with no investment relevance beyond illustrating typical seasonal retail discount depth.
insights.quote: $390 is the lowest price it's seen all year.
insights.locator: But Home Depot's steepest discount is on Traeger's

insights.claim: Home Depot is running its usual buy-one-get-one-free battery bundle promotions on Milwaukee and Ryobi power tools during the 2026 Labor Day sale, including a free M18 impact driver with purchase of Milwaukee's M18 battery.
insights.speaker: Matthew Korfhage
insights.so_what: Illustrates a recurring seasonal retail promotional pattern (BOGO battery deals) rather than any business or market-moving development.

insights.claim: The article's author explicitly advises against Home Depot's smart-home and home-security deals this sale cycle, saying they are either weak discounts or apply to older models or services like Ring that WIRED does not recommend on privacy grounds.
insights.speaker: Matthew Korfhage
insights.so_what: A reviewer explicitly steering shoppers away from a smart-home brand over privacy concerns is a minor reputational signal for Ring/Amazon, though it carries no direct financial data.
insights.quote: The smart home and home-security deals I've seen for Home Depot are either not great deals—or they're on older models or services like Ring that WIRED doesn't recommend for privacy reasons.
insights.locator: Alas, not everything is a winner
